parts.text: The diagram shows an athlete releasing the hammer at a speed of V m/s at an angle A to the horizontal. A is the release angle. The athlete releases the hammer at a speed of 20 m/s with release angle 30°. As the hammer travels it moves both vertically and horizontally as shown. This is a model for the vertical speed S m/s.

content.tex: The diagram shows an athlete releasing the hammer at a speed of V m/s at an angle A to the horizontal. A is the release angle.
The athlete releases the hammer at a speed of 20m/s with release angle \(30^{\circ}.\)
As the hammer travels it moves both vertically and horizontally as shown.
This is a model for the vertical speed \(S\) m/s.
